scope: Read-only exact name discovery from current government and public directory sources. No workbook edits.
matching_rule: Require exact workbook SFA licence, six-digit postal code, street address, and unit; corroborate the public-facing stall name from authoritative source(s); no name-only or fuzzy joins.

sources.evidence: 2025 Outstanding Hawker Mentor Award annex lists Xu Can Bin, Long Ding Seafood, Kampung Admiralty Hawker Centre / #02-12.
Current directory lists Long Ding Seafood - Kampung Admiralty at 676 Woodlands Drive 71, Singapore 730676.

proposals.scope: Name-only proposal. The workbook SFA licence row uniquely matches exact address, unit and postal code. Sources support the public-facing stall name; no other fields are proposed.
limitations: NEA award release is the exact-unit name source but was published in November 2025; the 2026 community directory corroborates brand and centre/address but does not display unit number. Current operation at the exact unit was not independently observed in person.
Do not infer hours, menu, contact details, image or other attributes from this name evidence.
